Description: Operation records reference Model and ModelState but do not explicitly require a canonical model_role or physical_source_of_truth binding. This leaves operation targets ambiguous against the DEL-02-01 physical source-of-truth role for editable design data.
ProposedDisposition: Technically addressed: OperationSet now requires OperationModelBasis with canonical_model_role=physical_source_of_truth, physical_source_of_truth_ref, accepted_model_state_ref, and accepted_model_state_hash; preview blocks non-physical accepted model states and stale/missing model-state hashes.

SectionRef: schema-conformant fixture validation; operation/category coverage; quantity/provenance/checksum assertions
Description: The expected operation fixtures were not present for audit. Without schema-conformant fixtures, the audit could not check category coverage, explicit unit metadata, provenance, checksum references, and round-trip assumptions on concrete operation examples.
ProposedDisposition: Technically addressed: added invented schema-conformant operation and accepted-state fixtures covering operation/change categories, accepted PKG-02 dimension IDs, provenance metadata, required model-state checksums, and round-trip assumption evidence.
